In the case of loss of cabin pressure,
the oxygen mask
will automatically be released from the passenger service
unit above your seat. Pull it down and towards you, hold
it firmly over both nose and mouth and breathe normally.
DO NOT SMOKE during oxygen distribution.

Tire de ella hacia abajo y hacia usted, sujétela firmemente
contra la nariz y la boca y respire normalmente.
